description: ESPN MLB scoreboard for one date: every game with away and home team, score, status (scheduled, live, final), and venue, from ESPN's public site JSON. Times are UTC. Scores match the MLB Stats API for final games. Related tools on this server, for a different need: dev_espn_nba_scoreboard when you need ESPN NBA scoreboard for one date: every game with away; dev_espn_nfl_scoreboard when you need ESPN NFL scoreboard for one date: every game with home. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: dev_espn_mlb_scoreboard
